title: MemoryStand
_notes: GENERAL-PUBLIC CUT. The story is understandable without prior knowledge of AI agents, vector databases, or cloud operations.
Editorial rule: explain the safety boundary with one analogy — a memory must show its receipt before it gets the keys.
Seven beats and twelve short Grok presenter shots keep the public cut close to 1:45. Each line is 17-24 words.
Panels use one headline and no more than two short keypoints. Paragraphs belong in documentation, not in the film.
Selected shots replace the synthetic presenter with muted footage from the deployed evidence cut while retaining the verified narration.
The live-evidence shots prove that the project functions and visibly show the CockroachDB memory layer and AWS outcome gate.
Current limitation is explicit: search matches words rather than meaning, and /decide used a fixed fallback because paid model quota was unavailable.
That runtime limitation never changes the authority path: promotion is deterministic, externally checked, and uses zero model calls.
Every generated shot must pass transcript comparison before compose.py will include it.
The final MP4 burns English subtitles into the image and also writes a selectable English SRT.

shots: AI assistants remember past fixes. MemoryStand stops those memories from acting alone until outside evidence proves they actually worked.
Think of it this way: every memory must show a receipt before it gets the keys to act.

panelData.headline:
A COINCIDENCE
CAN BECOME A FALSE MEMORY.

shots: An engineer restarts a service, the alert stops, and everyone remembers the restart as the fix forever.
But the service's real performance never improved. The story sounds true, yet repeating it could make the next outage worse.

panelData.headline:
COCKROACHDB
KEEPS THE AUDIT TRAIL.
panelData.footnote: CockroachDB Cloud · VECTOR(512) · C-SPANN · AS OF SYSTEM TIME

shots: MemoryStand keeps the claim, source, trust level, and decision history together in CockroachDB, so every action remains auditable.

panelData.footnote: Every change remains linked to its source.

shots: When two memories disagree, MemoryStand does not quietly overwrite either one. Weaker evidence waits for a person to review.

panelData.headline:
CLOUDWATCH
IS THE RECEIPT.
panelData.footnote: Live AWS outcome receipts · promotion path model_calls: 0

shots: To earn the keys, a memory must match AWS CloudWatch data for the same service, metric, direction, and size.
If the evidence matches, the memory becomes verified. If anything important disagrees, MemoryStand refuses autonomous use for safety.

panelData.headline:
0% OF ATTACKS
GOT THE KEYS.
panelData.footnote: 600 fixed cases · autonomous authority scored separately

shots: We tested five hundred forty attack cases and sixty honest controls, measuring whether each memory received autonomous authority.
Trusting the caller gave every attack the keys. MemoryStand blocked every attack from autonomous control and preserved every honest case.

panelData.headline: HONEST STATUS.
panelData.footnote: Model route HTTP 402 · authority gate model_calls: 0 · hackathon candidate

shots: Today, search is basic rather than meaning-aware. Decisions use a fixed fallback, while the safety gate still demands outside evidence.
That gate uses zero model calls. MemoryStand gives autonomous keys only to memories that prove what really happened.

outro.tagline: A memory must show its receipt before it gets the keys.
